app.name: Jube
nav.label: Main navigation
home.title: Jube Vue scaffolding
home.intro: Each card below exercises one part of the stack under Vue Vapor. Phase 0 is complete when every card reports that it works.
home.vaporBody: This page is a Vapor component rendered inside a Vapor app, with the router view interoperating through the Vapor interop plugin.
home.piniaBody: Theme preference held in the UI store: {theme}.
home.queryBody: The API and cache page drives vue-query through the single useApi function.
home.iconsBody: Lucide icons render as Vapor-compatible components.
grid.title: Data grid
grid.intro: One DataGrid component owns the only Tabulator import. Filter and sort live in the URL.
api.title: API and cache
api.intro: A read goes through useApi and vue-query. Errors map to the standard states.
api.unauthorized: Not signed in. Normally this redirects to the sign-in page and keeps the return address.
api.conflict: This record changed. Reload to continue.
api.server: The server could not complete the request.
api.network: The server could not be reached.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your Jube account to continue.
login.mfa.title: Verify it is you
login.mfa.intro: Enter the code from your security token to finish signing in.
login.mfa.label: Verification code
login.mfa.hint: Digits only, exactly as your token shows them.
login.change.title: Choose a new password
login.change.intro: Your password must be changed before you can continue. The new password replaces the old one for every future sign-in.
login.rules.title: Your new password needs
login.rules.repeat: No character repeated more than twice in a row
login.rules.common: Not starting with a common pattern such as 123456
login.errors.invalid: The details were not accepted. Check them and try again.
login.errors.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
login.errors.weak: The new password does not meet every requirement.
login.errors.rejected: The server did not accept the request.
login.errors.unavailable: Jube could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
login.redirecting: Taking you to your organisation’s sign-in…
login.negotiateFailed: Your computer did not sign you in automatically, and this installation does not accept a password. Check you are signed in to your organisation’s network, then try again.
notFound.title: Page not found
theme.title: Theme
theme.intro: Every daisyUI component the port is expected to use, in the current theme and direction. Switch theme and language to check both.
theme.contrastHint: Each swatch shows its text colour on its background, measured at runtime. Body text needs at least 4.5:1.
theme.name: Name
theme.accentRule: Teal, gold and green are fills with dark ink on top, never text on white, so accent, warning and success have no outline, soft or link variants.
theme.dataGrid: Data display uses Tabulator everywhere; daisyUI tables are not used.
shell.signOutFailed: Sign-out failed. Check your connection and try again.
shell.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
shell.sessionWarning: Your session is about to expire.
shell.tenantMore: Showing the first {count}. Keep typing to narrow the list.
notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.labelUnread: no notifications | one unread notification | {count} unread notifications
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing new. Notifications will appear here once the notification service is connected.
errors.forbidden: You are not permitted to do that.
errors.conflict: That record changed. Reload it and try again.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection.
errors.notFound: That record could not be found.
errors.server: The server could not complete the request.
tools.title: Tools workbench
tools.intro: Temporary workbench for porting the shared page tools from the old interface. Pick a tool to work on it; the choice is kept in the address.
tools.empty: Nothing here yet. This is where {tool} will be built and tried.
valueGrid.title: Values
valueGrid.loadFailed: The values could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.
valueGrid.empty: No values match the current filter.
valueGrid.statusUnavailable: Approval status is unavailable. Reload to check.
valueGrid.confirmBody: It stays listed as a pending deletion until a checker approves it.
valueGrid.bench.choose: Choose a list or dictionary and enter its id.
statistics.title: Column statistics
statistics.histogramLabel: Distribution of {bins} bins from {min} to {max}, most values near {peak} ({count})
watcher.mode.label: Map shows
watcher.window.label: Window
watcher.fade.label: Fade over
watcher.replayFailed: The replay could not be loaded.
watcher.mapFailed: The map could not start in this browser. The feed and summary below still work.

watcher.impossibleCount: No impossible travel | 1 impossible journey | {count} impossible journeys
watcher.summaryEmpty: The summary appears once activations arrive.
watcher.page.loadFailed: The watcher could not be opened. Refresh the page to try again.
watcher.page.refused: You do not have permission to see the activation watcher.
csvExport.title: CSV export
csvExport.note: No separate export widget: the grid's own download writes the file. Excel carries the styling (header, column widths, real numbers and dates, frozen header row, filter); CSV is the plain, unstyled alternative. Cells that start like a formula are neutralised in the CSV.

crud.noList: This record type has no list to show.
crud.problems: no problems | {count} problem to fix | {count} problems to fix
